# pvecli vm migrate

Migrate a VM to another node of the cluster.

A running VM moves live. The target is checked first: storage missing on
it, local resources or HA constraints are refused with their reason.

```text
pvecli vm migrate [VMID] [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMID` | VM ID. |
| `TARGET` | Target node (menu when omitted). |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `--online` / `--offline` | Live migration (default when the VM runs). |
| `--with-local-disks` | Copy local disks during a live migration. |
| `--target-storage VALUE` | Storage on the target, or a source:target mapping. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## Examples

```bash
pvecli vm migrate 100 pve2
pvecli vm migrate 100 pve2 --with-local-disks
pvecli vm migrate 100              # pick the target node
```
